# The Linux Information Project (LINFO)

> A comprehensive educational resource providing definitions, tutorials, and documentation on Linux, Unix, open-source software, and computer fundamentals.

LINFO is a free, community-driven project dedicated to making Linux and Unix knowledge accessible to everyone from beginners to advanced users. The site contains detailed reference material, how-to guides, command documentation, and historical context about the development of Unix and Linux operating systems.

## Key Topics

- Linux
- Unix-like operating systems
- Free software
- System administration
- Command reference
- Kernel
- Linus Torvalds
- Ken Thompson
- Bell Labs
- PDP-7
- Linux distributions
- File systems
- Shell commands
- Open-source software
- Computer fundamentals

## Core Navigation & Site Information

- [Complete index for pages on The Linux Information Project web site](https://linfo.org/main_index.html): Complete site index and directory of all LINFO documentation and topics
- [What is LINFO?](https://linfo.org/linfo_about.html): About The Linux Information Project, its mission, and history

## Linux Fundamentals & Definitions

- [Linux definition by The Linux Information Project (LINFO)](https://linfo.org/linuxdef.html): Comprehensive definition of Linux, its history, kernel, and Unix-like nature
- [Free software definition by The Linux Information Project (LINFO)](https://linfo.org/free_software.html): Definition and explanation of free software vs proprietary software
- [What is root? -- definition by The Linux Information Project (LINFO)](https://linfo.org/root.html): Definition of root user, superuser permissions, and system administration
- [What is a hard link? -- definition by The Linux Information Project (LINFO)](https://linfo.org/hard_link.html): Explanation of hard links, inodes, and filesystem concepts in Linux

## Command Reference & Tutorials

- [Index of commands explained by The Linux Information Project](https://linfo.org/command_index.html): Comprehensive index of Linux commands and shell command reference
- [Linux "How-To" Articles index](https://linfo.org/how-to_index.html): Index of how-to guides, tutorials, and installation articles for Linux
- [How to use the head command - by The Linux Information Project (LINFO)](https://linfo.org/head.html): Guide to using the head command for text processing and file operations
- [How to use the umount command, by The Linux Information Project](https://linfo.org/umount.html): Tutorial on umount command for filesystem unmounting and device management

## Getting Started with Linux

- [Linux for newbies: advantages, why and how to study, installation, alternatives](https://linfo.org/newbies.html): Beginner's guide to Linux with installation, advantages, and study resources

## Computer Fundamentals & Concepts

- [Byte definition by The Linux Information Project (LINFO)](https://linfo.org/byte.html): Definition of byte, binary representation, and computer memory fundamentals
- [Characters: the building blocks of writing systems](https://linfo.org/character.html): Character sets, Unicode, and text encoding for internationalization

## History & Origins

- [The PDP-7 was used by Thompson for first version of UNIX](https://linfo.org/pdp-7.html): Historical overview of PDP-7 minicomputer and early Unix development
